These queries are written from the documentation page alone and none were run. Several rest on guesses about verbs the page doesn't spell out, so some may fail:
- Keyword-to-string conversion in T8 and T13 uses `print | drop 1`, which assumes `print` of a keyword gives ":name".
- `entries` is assumed to give `[key value]` pairs.
- `desc` is assumed to work as a sort key.
- `at 1` is assumed to read a vector index softly.

T1: /data/users | filter ~(allOf /active (at :email | coalesce "" | lower | endsWith "@example.com")) | count
T2: /data/users | filter ~(/roles | any ~(lower | eq "admin")) | sort ~([(/name | lower)]) | * /name
T3: /data/users | groupBy ~(at :profile | coalesce {} | at :country | coalesce "unknown" | keyword) | * count
T4: /data/users | * (at :profile | coalesce {} | at :age) | filter ~(ne null) | avg | mul 100 | round | div 100
T5: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | * /labels | flat | * (/name | lower) | distinct | sort
T6: sort ~([(/comments | desc) /number]) | take 3 | * {:number /number :assignee (at :assignee | coalesce {} | at :login)}
T7: filter ~(allOf (/state | eq "open") (at :assignee | ne null)) | groupBy ~(/assignee/login | keyword) | * count
T8: [/dependencies /devDependencies] | * entries | flat | filter ~(/1 | startsWith "^") | sort ~(/0) | * ([(/0 | print | drop 1) /1] | join "@")
T9: /services | filter ~(allOf (at :enabled | eq true) (/port | gt 8000)) | * (/name | lower) | sort | join ","
T10: lines | filter ~(split " " | at 1 | eq "ERROR") | groupBy ~(split " " | /2 | keyword) | * count
T11: lines | * (split " " | filter ~(startsWith "ms=")) | filter ~(count | gt 0) | * (/0 | drop 3 | parseJson) | avg | mul 10 | round | div 10
T12: lines | drop 1 | * split "," | filter ~(count | gt 5) | filter ~(allOf (/5 | lower | eq "shipped") (/4 | ne "")) | * (mulOf (/3 | parseJson) (/4 | parseJson)) | sum | mul 100 | round | div 100
T13: lines | drop 1 | * split "," | filter ~(count | gt 5) | filter ~(allOf (/5 | lower | ne "cancelled") (/4 | ne "")) | groupBy ~(/1 | keyword) | * (* (mulOf (/3 | parseJson) (/4 | parseJson)) | sum | mul 100 | round | div 100) | entries | * {:customer (/0 | print | drop 1) :total /1} | sort ~([(/total | desc)]) | take 2
T14: ["Banana","apple","Cherry","banana","fig","APPLE","date","kiwi","Fig","elderberry"] | * lower | distinct | sort ~([(count | desc) /]) | join "-"
